\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Threshold Functions --- Affine Khintchine}

\section{Overview}
Coordinate influences and antipodal symmetry give a sharp affine comparison between the first absolute moment and the coefficient second moment.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Absolute values decrease coordinate influence]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.influence_abs_le}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_mono, BooleanAnalysis.flipBit, BooleanAnalysis.influence}
\difficulty{3}
Let $n\ge0$ and equip $\{0,1\}^n$ with its uniform probability measure; write $\mathbb E$ for uniform expectation. Write $x^{\{i\}}$ for $x$ with bit $i$ flipped, $I_i(h)=\mathbb E[(h(x)-h(x^{\{i\}}))^2]/4$, and $I(h)=\sum_i I_i(h)$. For every real function $h$ on the cube and coordinate $i\in[n]$, $I_i(|h|)\le I_i(h)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Opposite affine values sum to the constant part]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.affine_sum_antipode}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.HasDegreeAtMost, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.eval, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.eval_of_degree_le_one, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign_not}
\difficulty{3}
Let $n\ge0$ and equip $\{0,1\}^n$ with its uniform probability measure; write $\mathbb E$ for uniform expectation. For $S\subseteq[n]$, put $\chi_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}(-1)^{x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\mathbb E[h\chi_S]$ for real cube functions $h$. Let $P(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}a_S\chi_S(x)$ with real coefficients $a_S$. Suppose $a_S=0$ whenever $|S|>1$. For every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, $P(x)+P(\bar x)=2a_\varnothing$, where $\bar x_i=1-x_i$.
\end{lemma}
